item.title: FAA Halts All Flights at El Paso Airport for 10 Days
Communities Are Not Fungible
item.description:
📝 Jacobs understood that the value of a community isn't in the people as discrete units. Community is what you get when agents stop being interchangeable to each other. The startup that launches a Discord server and calls it a community // the coworking space that holds a monthly mixer and calls it a community etc.
🔗 Read more: https://www.joanwestenberg.com/communities-are-not-fungible/
